### Asignando niveles a las variables categoricas
```{r}
# Niveles de las variables categóricas
factor_mappings <- lapply(df, function(x) {
  if (is.factor(x)) {
    data.frame(Level = levels(x), Code = seq_along(levels(x)))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
})
```

## PCA

```{r}
pca_resultado <- prcomp(df, 
                        center = TRUE,  # Por defecto TRUE
                        scale. = TRUE) 
```

```{r}
summary(pca_resultado)
```

```{r}
plot(pca_resultado$sdev^2, 
     type = "b", 
     main = "Varianza explicada por componente",
     xlab = "Componentes", 
     ylab = "Varianza")
```

```{r}
var_acumulada <- cumsum(pca_resultado$sdev^2 / sum(pca_resultado$sdev^2))
num_componentes <- which(var_acumulada >= 0.90)[1]
print(paste("Número óptimo de componentes:", num_componentes))
```

## Gaussian mixture model clustering
```{r}
library(mclust)

gmm_model <- Mclust(df_scaled)
```
```{r}
summary(gmm_model)

```

```{r}
# plot(gmm_model, what = "classification")
clusters <- gmm_model$classification
print(clusters)

```
```{r}
cluster_assignments <- predict(gmm_model)$classification

# Visualize the results
plot(df_scaled, col = cluster_assignments, main = "GMM Clustering Results")
points(gmm_model$parameters$mean, col = 1:3, pch = 8, cex = 2)
```
```{r}
fviz_cluster(object = gmm_model, #
             data = df_scaled, # data used for clustering
             ellipse.type = "norm",
             geom = "point",
             palette = "jco",
             main = "",
             ggtheme = theme_minimal())
```

## DBSCAN
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(dbscan)    # For DBSCAN
library(cluster)   # For silhouette score
library(ggplot2)   # For visualization



# --- Step 1: Run DBSCAN ---
# Parameters:
# - eps: Neighborhood radius (adjust based on your data scale)
# - minPts: Minimum points to form a cluster (start with 5)
dbscan_result <- dbscan::dbscan(df_scaled, eps = 0.5, minPts = 5)
dbscan_result

# Extract cluster labels (Note: -1 = noise/outliers)
clusters <- dbscan_result$cluster
table(clusters)  # Check cluster distribution


# --- Step 3: Visualize Clusters ---
data$cluster <- as.factor(clusters)

ggplot(data, aes(x = Dim1, y = Dim2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "DBSCAN Clustering",
       subtitle = paste("eps = 0.5, minPts = 5 | Noise points (cluster -1) in black")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
fviz_cluster(object = dbscan_result, # kmeans object 
             data = df_scaled, # data used for clustering
             ellipse.type = "norm",
             geom = "point",
             palette = "jco",
             main = "",
             ggtheme = theme_minimal())
```
